message.content: For the Statewide Insurance Commissioner race, Jane Kim (D) carries the strongest pro-Palestine-aligned directional evidence among recorded candidates. CAIR Action endorsed her in the general phase, Vote for Peace rated her Ally and supported her in the general phase, AROC Action endorsed her, and Ro Khanna endorsed her. Vote for Peace also reports that Kim pledged to reject war-lobby support and favors divesting public funds from war crimes and genocide, though the underlying pledge date is not supplied. Her Israel-aligned record includes endorsements from Iranian American Democrats of California, Asian Pacific American Democratic Caucus of Alameda County, California Armenian American Democrats, Americans for Democratic Action SoCal, and Asian American Pacific Islander Democratic Club of San Diego. By contrast, Ben Allen (D) is rated Opposed by Vote for Peace in the general phase and endorsed by the Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club in the primary phase, carried forward. Allen publicly supported the deletion of anti-Israel language from state party resolutions in 2019 and, in a questionnaire response, opposed BDS and cited supporting Israel's right to exist and defend itself.
